SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), faplicacion,103) AS fAplicacion, Isnull(cconcepto, 'Escriba un concepto') AS cConcepto, ctipoanexo AS cTipoAnexo, cidcontrato AS cIdContratoCompromiso, '$' + CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), mimporte, 103 ) AS importeTotal, Isnull(nidestatus, 0) AS nIdEstatus, Isnull(cmotivorechazo, '') AS cMotivoRechazo FROM tanexo1encabezado WITH(nolock) WHERE nfolioanexo1 = ?
SELECT Upper(Isnull(cdocumentohaplicado, 'N')) AS cDocumentoHAplicado FROM tanexo1encabezado WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nfolioanexo1 = ?

IF ? = 'RELACIONGASTOS' SELECT descripcion, nombre_elemento FROM ( SELECT 'Seleccione un destino' AS descripcion, -1 AS nombre_elemento UNION SELECT descripcion, posicion_elemento AS nombre_elemento FROM imx_estruc_doctos WITH(nolock) WHERE prioridad < 0 AND titulo_aplicacion = ? UNION SELECT 'Alimentacion a Brigadistas' AS descripcion, 10 AS nombre_elemento UNION SELECT 'Juegos Deportivos' AS descripcion, 11 AS nombre_elemento ) AS tbl ORDER BY nombre_elemento ELSE SELECT descripcion, nombre_elemento FROM ( SELECT 'Seleccione un destino' AS descripcion, -1 AS nombre_elemento UNION SELECT descripcion, posicion_elemento AS nombre_elemento FROM imx_estruc_doctos WITH(nolock) WHERE prioridad < 0 AND titulo_aplicacion = ? ) AS tbl ORDER BY nombre_elemento

IF ( ? = 'RELACIONGASTOS' AND ? = 11) SELECT 'Seleccione un documento' AS descripcion, -1 AS posicion_elemento UNION SELECT 'Juegos Deportivos' AS descripcion, 0 AS posicion_elemento ORDER BY 2 ELSE IF ( ? = 'RELACIONGASTOS' AND ? = 10) SELECT 'Seleccione un documento' AS descripcion, -1 AS posicion_elemento UNION SELECT 'Alimentacion a Brigadistas' AS descripcion, 0 AS posicion_elemento ORDER BY 2 ELSE SELECT 'Seleccione un documento' AS descripcion, -1 AS posicion_elemento UNION SELECT descripcion, posicion_elemento FROM dbo.fn_lee_elementos(?, ?) ORDER BY 2

SELECT Count(*) AS esPagoFID FROM tpagofederalizadodetalle WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ( Substring(ep, 57, 3) IN(SELECT nidprograma FROM tfideicomiso WITH(NOLOCK)) OR Substring(ep, 61, 3) IN(SELECT nidprograma FROM tfideicomiso WITH(NOLOCK)) ) AND nfoliopagofederalizado = ?

SELECT Count(*) AS esPagoFID FROM tRELACIONGASTOSDetalle WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ( Substring(ep, 57, 3) IN(SELECT nidprograma FROM tfideicomiso WITH(NOLOCK)) OR Substring(ep, 61, 3) IN(SELECT nidprograma FROM tfideicomiso WITH(NOLOCK)) ) AND nFolioRELACIONGASTOS = ?

SELECT TOP 1 cPrograma FROM (SELECT Substring(ep, 57, 3) AS cPrograma FROM tpagofederalizadodetalle detalle WITH(nolock) INNER JOIN dbo.tfideicomiso fideicomiso WITH(nolock) ON Substring(detalle.ep, 57, 3) = fideicomiso.nidprograma WHERE nfoliopagofederalizado = ? UNION SELECT Substring(ep, 61, 3) AS cPrograma FROM tpagofederalizadodetalle detalle WITH(nolock) INNER JOIN dbo.tfideicomiso fideicomiso WITH(nolock) ON Substring(detalle.ep, 61, 3) = fideicomiso.nidprograma WHERE nfoliopagofederalizado = ? ) AS unidades

SELECT TOP 1 cPrograma FROM (SELECT Substring(ep, 57, 3) AS cPrograma FROM trelaciongastosdetalle detalle WITH(nolock) INNER JOIN dbo.tfideicomiso fideicomiso WITH(nolock) ON Substring(detalle.ep, 57, 3) = fideicomiso.nidprograma WHERE nfoliorelaciongastos = ? UNION SELECT Substring(ep, 61, 3) AS cPrograma FROM trelaciongastosdetalle detalle WITH(nolock) INNER JOIN dbo.tfideicomiso fideicomiso WITH(nolock) ON Substring(detalle.ep, 61, 3) = fideicomiso.nidprograma WHERE nfoliorelaciongastos = ? ) AS unidades
SELECT cprograma, id AS idFideicomiso FROM tfideicomiso WITH(nolock) WHERE nidprograma = ? UNION SELECT 'Seleccione una opcion' AS cprograma, '00' AS idFideicomiso ORDER BY 2

SELECT DISTINCT cprograma cProgramaDesc, id AS idFideicomiso FROM tfideicomiso fid WITH(nolock) INNER JOIN tVistasUR vista (NOLOCK) ON fid.nidprograma = vista.ur WHERE usuario = ? AND modulo = 'TESORERIA' UNION SELECT 'Seleccione una opcion' AS cprograma, '-1' AS idFideicomiso ORDER BY 2

SELECT cIdRFC cIDRFC, dNombre + ' ' + ISNULL(dApellidoPaterno,'') + ' ' + ISNULL(dApellidoMaterno ,'') cnombre FROM pContratoFederalizado CONTRATO WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tBeneficiario BEN WITH(NOLOCK) ON BEN.dRFC = CONTRATO.cIdRFC WHERE cIdContrato = ?
SELECT cdescsubprograma cSubProgramaDesc, csubprograma FROM tprogramafideicomiso WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE id = ? UNION SELECT 'Seleccione una opcion' AS cSubProgramaDesc, '-1' AS csubprograma ORDER BY 2
SELECT '<< SELECCIONE TIPO DE LIBERACION >>' AS cDESCRIPCIONREINTEGRO, 0 AS ID_REINTEGRO UNION SELECT cDESCRIPCIONREINTEGRO, ID_REINTEGRO FROM tCatalogo_Reintegros WITH (NOLOCK)

if (? <> 146) SELECT '<< SELECCIONE >>' AS EDO_NOMBRE, 0 AS ID_ESTADO UNION SELECT EDO_NOMBRE, ID_ESTADO FROM dbo.CAT_ESTADOS WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ID_PAIS = ? UNION SELECT 'AGREGAR ESTADO' AS EDO_NOMBRE, 9999 AS ID_ESTADO ELSE SELECT '<< SELECCIONE >>' AS EDO_NOMBRE, 0 AS ID_ESTADO UNION SELECT EDO_NOMBRE, ID_ESTADO FROM dbo.CAT_ESTADOS WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ID_PAIS = ?

if (? <= 32) SELECT '<< SELECCIONE >>' AS MPO_NOMBRE, 0 AS ID_MUNICIPIO UNION SELECT MPO_NOMBRE, ID_MUNICIPIO FROM dbo.CAT_MUNICIPIO WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ID_ESTADO = ? ORDER BY 1 ELSE SELECT '<< SELECCIONE >>' AS MPO_NOMBRE, 0 AS ID_MUNICIPIO UNION SELECT MPO_NOMBRE, ID_MUNICIPIO FROM dbo.CAT_MUNICIPIO WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ID_ESTADO = ? UNION SELECT 'AGREGAR CIUDAD/MUNICIPIO' AS MPO_NOMBRE, 9999 AS ID_ESTADO ORDER BY 1
SELECT ID_ESTADO estado FROM dbo.CAT_ESTADOS WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EDO_NOMBRE = ?
SELECT ID_MUNICIPIO municipio from CAT_MUNICIPIO WITH(NOLOCK) where MPO_NOMBRE = ?
SELECT cCveTipoMoneda, id cMoneda FROM tCatalogoTipoMoneda WITH(NOLOCK) order by id
SELECT mmontodiario cCuota FROM tCatalogoTipoMoneda WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE id = ?

SELECT COUNT(*) otroTipoCambio FROM tComision comision WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tAgenda agenda WITH (NOLOCK) ON comision.nIdComision = agenda.nIdComision INNER JOIN tViaticos viat WITH (NOLOCK) ON agenda.nidAgenda = viat.nidAgenda WHERE viat.mTipoCambio not in ( 0, 1 ) AND comision.nIdComision = ?
SELECT mImporteTipoCambio FROM tComision WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nIdComision = ?
SELECT nombreCompleto cnombre, cUR, cPlaza, nEmpleado, cNivel, cUejecutora FROM v_empleados WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cIDRFC = ?
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 then 1 else 0 end cTieneBoleto FROM v_AutorizaFirmantesViaticos WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nIdEmpleado = ? and cTieneBoleto = 'SI'
SELECT cnombre FROM v_Empleados WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nEmpleado = ?
SELECT ID_TIPOREINTEGRO FROM tReintegroEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioReintegro = ?

SELECT TOP 1 detalle.RFC FROM tPagadoEncabezado encabezado WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN tPagadoDetalle detalle WITH(NOLOCK) ON encabezado.nFolioPagado = detalle.nFolioPagado WHERE caNoContrarrecibo = ?
SELECT tc_descripcion, tc_gaveta_asociada FROM vTramitesAdjuntaMasivo WITH(NOLOCK)
SELECT ISNULL(clineaCaptura,'') AS cLineaCaptura , ISNULL(nMes,0) AS nMes FROM dbo.tOperAjenasIntegradoEnc WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioOperAjenasInt = ?
SELECT CASE WHEN mMontoAnticipoConIVA > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tieneAnticipo FROM mRecepcionpMatAnticipoEjerciciosAnt WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cidpedcontdef = ?
SELECT aEjercicioFiscal as nAnio FROM tEjercicioFiscal WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE cActivo = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) as existeFirmantes FROM tFirmanteModulo firmantes WITH(nolock) WHERE firmantes.cModulo=? AND firmantes.cUnidadResponsable = ? AND firmantes.cTipoFirmante = ?
SELECT nTipo as cEventoTipo FROM dbo.tSaldoAntiguedadEventos WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cEvento LIKE ?
SELECT cTipo as cSaldoTipo FROM dbo.tSaldoAntiguedadEventos WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cEvento LIKE ?
SELECT '<< SELECCIONE >>' AS strNombreBeneficiario, '000' AS ctaBancariaCNF UNION SELECT cNombreBanco, cClabe FROM tCatCuentasBancariasViaticos WITH (NOLOCK)
SELECT '<< SELECCIONE >>' AS cPais, 0 AS nIdPais UNION SELECT cPais, nIdPais FROM dbo.tCatalogoPaises WITH (NOLOCK) order by cPais
SELECT '<< SELECCIONE >>' AS cDescripcion , '' AS nIdTransporte UNION SELECT dTransporte, nIdTransporte FROM dbo.tCatTipoTransporte WITH (NOLOCK) order by nidtransporte
SELECT '<< SELECCIONE >>' AS dTipoComision, '0' nidtipo UNION SELECT dtipoComision, nidtipo from tCatTipoComision WITH (NOLOCK)

SELECT '<< SELECCIONE >>' AS nivelHomologa, '0' nIdHomologacion UNION SELECT cHomologacion, nIdHomologacion FROM tCatHomologacionComision WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nActivo = 1 AND cNiveles NOT LIKE '%'+ ? + '%'
SELECT cHomologacion, nIdHomologacion, mImporteMX cCuota FROM tCatHomologacionComision WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nActivo = 1 and nIdHomologacion = ?
SELECT cHomologacion, nIdHomologacion, mImporteME cCuota FROM tCatHomologacionComision WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nActivo = 1 and nIdHomologacion = ?

SELECT COUNT(*) tieneComSinViaticos FROM tRelacionComprobacionComisiones Rel WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tComisionesSinComprobacionEnc csc with (nolock) ON rel.nFolioTramite = csc.nFolioComision WHERE cTipoTramite = 'COMSINVIATICOS' AND nidComisionModulo = ? AND cDocumentoHAplicado = 'S'
SELECT CUOTA_PESOS cCuota FROM tviaticoscuotas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE niveles LIKE '%' + (SELECT cNivel FROM v_Empleados WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nEmpleado = ?) + '%'
SELECT cuota_dll cCuota FROM tviaticoscuotas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE niveles LIKE '%' + (SELECT cNivel FROM v_Empleados WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nEmpleado = ?) + '%'
SELECT cuota_euros cCuota FROM tviaticoscuotas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE niveles LIKE '%' + (SELECT cNivel FROM v_Empleados WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nEmpleado = ?) + '%'
SELECT '<< SELECCIONE >>' AS cNombre, '0' nIdPaquete UNION select cNombre, nIdPaquete from tCatPaquetesComision WITH (NOLOCK) where nActivo = 1
SELECT cNombre, nIdPaquete, nPorcentaje FROM tCatPaquetesComision WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nActivo = 1 and nIdPaquete = ?
SELECT count(*) registros FROM tAgenda WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nIdComision = ?
SELECT count(*) registros FROM tAgenda WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nIdComision = ? AND nidAgenda <> ?
SELECT nIdEmpleado nEmpleado FROM tComision WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nIdComision = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) dateExist FROM tAgenda WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nIdComision = ? AND ( ? BETWEEN fInicio AND DATEADD(DAY,-1,fFin))
SELECT COUNT(*) existeComision FROM tComision WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nIdComision = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) tieneExcepcionMA FROM tExcepcionMesesAnterioresViaticos WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE RFC = ?
SELECT count(*) existeTransporte FROM tTransporteLocal WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nIdComision = ?

SELECT SUM(DIAS) totalDias, SUM(cuotaSinFormato) totalAgenda , (SELECT ISNULL(sum(mmonto),0) FROM tTransporteLocal (NOLOCK) WHERE tTransporteLocal.nIdComision = v_AgendaViaticos.nIdComision) totalTransporte , SUM(cuotaSinFormato) + (SELECT ISNULL(sum(mmonto),0) FROM tTransporteLocal (NOLOCK) WHERE tTransporteLocal.nIdComision = v_AgendaViaticos.nIdComision) totalGeneral FROM v_AgendaViaticos where nIdComision = ? group by nIdComision
SELECT ISNULL(dbo.fn_diasNacional ( ?, ? ),0 ) diasNacional
SELECT ISNULL(dbo.fn_diasInternacional ( ?, ? ),0) diasInternacional
SELECT ISNULL(esSaldoInicial,0) AS esAntiguedadSI FROM dbo.tcajaencabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFoliocaja = ?

SELECT SUM(saldoPagos) saldoPagos FROM( SELECT CASE WHEN tipo IN ('A', 'X') THEN SUM(total) ELSE SUM(-total) END saldoPagos FROM v_RelacionComision WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nidComisionModulo = ? GROUP BY tipo ) AS SALDOS
SELECT COUNT(*) tieneComSinViat FROM v_RelacionComision WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nidComisionModulo = ? AND (cTipoTramite = 'COMSINVIATICOS' OR tipo = 'X')
SELECT SUM(mTotalAgenda + mTotalTransporte) saldoComision FROM tComision WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nIdComision = ?
SELECT SUM(total) saldoPagos FROM v_RelacionComision WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE tipo IN ('A', 'X') AND nidComisionModulo = ?
SELECT SUM(mTotalAgenda + mTotalTransporte) saldoComision FROM tComision WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nIdComision = ?

select COUNT(*) nComisionAnterior from tComision COMISION WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tAgenda AGENDA WITH (NOLOCK) ON COMISION.nIdComision = AGENDA.nIdComision where (cDocHaplicado IN ('S', 'F') or cDocHaplicado is null) AND nIdEmpleado = ? AND ? between fInicio and fFin and COMISION.nIdComision <> ?

select COUNT(*) nComisionAnteriorF from tComision COMISION WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tAgenda AGENDA WITH (NOLOCK) ON COMISION.nIdComision = AGENDA.nIdComision where (cDocHaplicado IN ('S', 'F') or cDocHaplicado is null) AND nIdEmpleado = ? AND ? between fInicio and fFin and COMISION.nIdComision <> ?

select COUNT(*) nComisionAnterior2 from tComision COMISION WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tAgenda AGENDA WITH (NOLOCK) ON COMISION.nIdComision = AGENDA.nIdComision where (cDocHaplicado IN ('S', 'F') or cDocHaplicado is null) AND nIdEmpleado = ? AND (AGENDA.fInicio between ? and ? OR AGENDA.fFin between ? and ? ) AND COMISION.nIdComision <> ?
SELECT COUNT(*) tieneInicidencia FROM v_inicidenciasNomina WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE c_empleado = ? AND ? between fFechaInicio and fFechaFin
SELECT COUNT(*) tieneInicidenciaF FROM v_inicidenciasNomina WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE c_empleado = ? AND ? between fFechaInicio and fFechaFin
SELECT subCuentaBancaria CTAB, subCuentaBancaria FROM tBeneficiarioCuentasBancarias WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE dRFC = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cantidadSA FROM dbo.tSaldoAntiguedadDetalle D (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.tSaldoAntiguedadEncabezado E (NOLOCK) ON D.nFolioSAEnc = E.nFolioSAEnc WHERE E.nFolioCaja = ?

SELECT STUFF(( SELECT ',' + CAST(D.nFolioSA AS VARCHAR(6)) FROM dbo.tSaldoAntiguedadDetalle D WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.tSaldoAntiguedadEncabezado E WITH (NOLOCK) ON D.nFolioSAEnc = E.nFolioSAEnc WHERE E.nFolioCaja = ? FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS arrFoliosSA

SELECT STUFF(( SELECT ',' + CAST(D.mImporte AS VARCHAR(13)) FROM dbo.tSaldoAntiguedadDetalle D (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.tSaldoAntiguedadEncabezado E (NOLOCK) ON D.nFolioSAEnc = E.nFolioSAEnc WHERE E.nFolioCaja = ? FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS arrMontosSA
SELECT D.nFolioSA AS arrFoliosSA FROM dbo.tSaldoAntiguedadDetalle D (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.tSaldoAntiguedadEncabezado E (NOLOCK) ON D.nFolioSAEnc = E.nFolioSAEnc WHERE E.nFolioCaja = ?
SELECT D.mImporte AS arrMontosSA FROM dbo.tSaldoAntiguedadDetalle D (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.tSaldoAntiguedadEncabezado E (NOLOCK) ON D.nFolioSAEnc = E.nFolioSAEnc WHERE E.nFolioCaja = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) esModuloViaticos FROM tRelacionComprobacionComisiones WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioTramite = ? AND cTipoTramite = 'CAJA' AND nidComisionModulo > 0
SELECT '<< SELECCIONE >>' AS dCuenta, 0 AS nIdPrograma UNION SELECT dCuenta, nIdPrograma FROM tCatProgramasProyectos WITH (NOLOCK) Order By nIdPrograma

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS existeFolio, ISNULL(cDocumentoHaplicado, '') as cDocumentoHaplicado FROM tRegistroIngresoEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioRegistroIngreso = ? GROUP BY cDocumentoHaplicado
SELECT cBtn1 as cBoton1, cRg1 as cRegistro1, cBtn2 as cBoton2, cRg2 as cRegistro2 FROM dbo.tSaldoAntiguedadEventos (NOLOCK) WHERE cEvento LIKE ?
SELECT nApartado AS apartado FROM tRegistroIngresoEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioRegistroIngreso = ?

SELECT CASE WHEN ( (PagoDirectoEncabezado.mImporteRetencion) - ( DocumentacionComprobatoriaDet.DCD_IVA + DocumentacionComprobatoriaDet.DCD_CONTRIBUCION + DocumentacionComprobatoriaDet.DCD_ISR + DocumentacionComprobatoriaDet.DCD_MIL5 + DocumentacionComprobatoriaDet.DCD_MIL2 + DocumentacionComprobatoriaDet.DCD_OTRAS_RET + DocumentacionComprobatoriaDet.DCD_PENALIZACION ) ) = 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS retencionPago FROM tPagoDirectoEncabezado PagoDirectoEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN v_pagosDocComprobatoria DocumentacionComprobatoriaDet WITH (NOLOCK) ON (DocumentacionComprobatoriaDet.caNoContrarrecibo = ?) WHERE PagoDirectoEncabezado.nFolioPagoDirecto = ?
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS existeRelacionComision FROM tRelacionComprobacionComisiones WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioTramite = ? AND cTipoTramite = ? AND cCentroContable = ?

SELECT pago.cFolioOficio AS cFolioOficio, pago.dFechaOficio AS dFechaOficio, ISNULL(pago.cNombreTitular, emp.NOMBREN) AS cNombreTitular, ISNULL(pago.cApellidoPaternoTitular, emp.NOMBREP) AS cPaternoTitular, ISNULL(pago.cApellidoMaternoTitular, emp.NOMBREM) AS cMaternoTitular, ISNULL(pago.cPuestoTitular, emp.CARGO) AS cPuestoTitular, pago.nTipoSuplencia AS tipoSuplencia, 'Existe' AS firmanteOficioExiste, pago.cNumeroEmpleado AS cboSuplenteAut FROM tPagoFirmanteDelagatorio pago WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN v_empleados_giro emp WITH (NOLOCK) ON emp.clave = pago.cNumeroEmpleado WHERE pago.cTipoPago = ? AND pago.nFolioPago = ?

SELECT cFolioOficio AS cFolioOficio, dFechaOficio AS dFechaOficio, cNombreTitular AS cNombreTitular, cApellidoPaternoTitular AS cPaternoTitular, cApellidoMaternoTitular AS cMaternoTitular, cPuestoTitular AS cPuestoTitular, nTipoSuplencia AS tipoSuplencia, 'Existe' AS firmanteOficioExiste , cNumeroEmpleado AS cboSuplenteAut FROM tPagoFirmanteDelagatorio WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cTipoPago = ? AND nFolioPago = ?

SELECT nIdComision, nFolioTramite, cTipoTramite, fAplicacion, RFC, cCuentaBeneficiario, mMontoComision FROM tRelacionComprobacionComisiones WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioTramite = ? AND cTipoTramite = ? AND cCentroContable = ?
SELECT nIdComision, fInicio AS fInicioComision, fFin AS fFinComision, cConcepto_Comision AS conceptoComision FROM v_ViaticosComisiones WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nIdComision = ?

SELECT cTipoPago, nFolioPago, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), CONVERT(DATE, fAplicacion), 103) AS fAplicacionPago, cIdRFC AS beneficiarioPago, cConcepto AS cConceptoPago, cUnidadResponsable AS urPago, caNoContrarrecibo AS cxpPago, CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), CONVERT(MONEY, importeBruto), 103) AS importeBrutoPago, CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), CONVERT(MONEY, importeNeto - importeBruto), 103) AS importeImpuestosPago, CONVERT(VARCHAR(32), CONVERT(MONEY, importeNeto), 103) AS importeTotalPago, cNombreProveedor, mImportePenalizacion AS mImportePenalizacionPago FROM vPenalizacionPendiente WHERE caNoContrarrecibo = ? AND cTipoPago = ?
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS esPartidaHospedaje FROM tCat_TipoPartidas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cPartida = ? AND cTipoPartida = ?

SELECT TOP 1 CASE WHEN RFC = ? THEN 'SI' ELSE 'NO' END AS esFIBBanorte FROM tpagadodetalle WITH(nolock) WHERE nfoliopagado = (SELECT nfoliopagado FROM tpagadoencabezado WHERE nfoliosicop = ? AND canocontrarrecibo = ?) AND mPasivoDiferido = 0
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS esPartidaViaticos FROM tCat_TipoPartidas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cPartida = ? AND cTipoPartida = 'Viaticos'

SELECT nIdComision, fInicio, fFin, cConcepto_Comision AS cConcepto, nIdPais AS cPais, ID_ESTADO AS estadocombo, ID_MUNICIPIO AS municipiocombo, cLocalidad FROM tViaticosComisiones WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nIdComision = ?
SELECT MAX(nIdComision) AS nIdComision FROM tViaticosComisiones WITH (NOLOCK)
SELECT TOP 1 CASE WHEN RFC = ? THEN 'SI' ELSE 'NO' END AS esFIBBanorte FROM tReintegroDetalle WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioReintegro = ?

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'SI' ELSE 'NO' END esViatico FROM tReintegroDetalle REINT WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN tPagadoEncabezado PAG WITH (NOLOCK) ON REINT.cxp = PAG.caNoContrarrecibo JOIN tPagadoDetalle PAGDET WITH (NOLOCK) ON PAG.nFolioPagado = PAGDET.nFolioPagado JOIN tEventoViaticos EVENTO WITH (NOLOCK) ON SUBSTRING(PAGDET.cEvento,3 + LEN(ID_TIPO_CONCEPTO),4) = EVENTO.cEvento WHERE nFolioReintegro = ?
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'SI' ELSE 'NO' END AS existeComisionReintegro FROM tComisionComprobacion REINT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioRelacion = ? AND cTipoPago = 'REINTEGRO'

SELECT C.nIdComision AS nIdComisionViatico, mPasaje, mTaxi, mPeaje, mHotel, mConsumos, mOtros, mPasajeLocal, mTaxiLocal, mGasolinaLocal, mPeajeLocal, mMaritimoLocal, mAereoLocal, C.cEvento AS cEventoComision, RG.RFC AS RFCEmpleado, SUBSTRING(RG.CTAB,7,12) AS cCuentaBeneficiario, RG.nIdComision AS nIdComisionRG, CASE WHEN C.cEvento = 'GCRE' THEN nFolioCaja ELSE '' END folioAnticipo, CASE WHEN C.cEvento = 'GCRE' THEN 'SI' ELSE 'NO' END esComprobacion FROM tComisionComprobacion C WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN tRELACIONGASTOSEncabezado RG WITH (NOLOCK) ON C.nFolioRelacion = RG.nFolioRELACIONGASTOS AND cTipoPago = 'RELACIONGASTOS' JOIN tReintegroDetalle R WITH (NOLOCK) ON RG.caNoContrarrecibo = R.cxp WHERE nFolioReintegro = ?

SELECT mPasaje AS mPasajeR, mTaxi AS mTaxiR, mPeaje AS mPeajeR, mHotel AS mHotelR, mConsumos AS mConsumosR, mOtros AS mOtrosR, mPasajeLocal AS mPasajeLocalR, mTaxiLocal AS mTaxiLocalR, mGasolinaLocal AS mGasolinaLocalR mPeajeLocal AS mPeajeLocalR, mMaritimoLocal AS mMaritimoLocalR, mAereoLocal AS mAereoLocalR FROM tComisionComprobacion C WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioRelacion = ? AND cTipoPago = 'REINTEGRO'

SELECT cprograma, id AS idFideicomiso FROM tfideicomiso WITH(nolock) WHERE ( nidprograma IN (SELECT SUBSTRING(EP, 57, 3) AS EP FROM tReintegroDetalle WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioReintegro = ?) OR nidprograma IN (SELECT SUBSTRING(EP, 61, 3) AS EP FROM tReintegroDetalle WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioReintegro = ?) OR id = '13' ) UNION SELECT 'Seleccione una opcion' AS cprograma, '000' AS idFideicomiso ORDER BY 2
SELECT nidprograma as nIDPrograma, cSubPrograma FROM tReintegroEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioReintegro = ?

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'SI' ELSE 'NO' END AS esPagoLayoutBan FROM tRELACIONGASTOSDetalle WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioRELACIONGASTOS = ? AND SUBSTRING(cEvento, 5, 20) NOT IN (SELECT cEvento FROM tCat_EventosSinLayoutBancario WITH (NOLOCK))

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'SI' ELSE 'NO' END AS esPagoLayoutBan FROM tPAGODIVERSODetalle WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioPAGODIVERSO = ? AND SUBSTRING(cEvento, 5, 20) NOT IN (SELECT cEvento FROM tCat_EventosSinLayoutBancario WITH (NOLOCK))
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS existeCXPRef FROM tPagadoEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE caNoContrarrecibo = ?
SELECT Count(*) AS nTotalRetenciones FROM tpagofacturaretencion WITH(nolock) WHERE ctipopago = ? AND nfoliopago = ? AND mimporteretencion <> 0
EXEC ListaRetencionesFactura ?, ?

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS esCXPPagoDiverso, LTRIM(RTRIM(cFolioPAGODIVERSO)) AS cIdContrato, cIdRecepMat AS cIdRecepcion FROM tPAGODIVERSOEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE caNoContrarrecibo = (SELECT TOP 1 cxp FROM tReintegroDetalle WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioReintegro = ? ) GROUP BY cFolioPAGODIVERSO, cIdRecepMat

SELECT CASE WHEN reintegro.importeLC = pago.mImporteNeto THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS esReinTotalParcial FROM tReintegroEncabezado reintegro WITH (NOLOCK), tPAGODIVERSOEncabezado pago WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE reintegro.nFolioReintegro = ? AND pago.caNoContrarrecibo = (SELECT TOP 1 cxp FROM tReintegroDetalle WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioReintegro = ? )
SELECT CASE WHEN isServicio = 1 THEN '2' WHEN isServicio = 0 THEN '1' ELSE '' END AS esRecepBienServicio FROM mRecepcionpMat WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cIdpedContDef = ? AND cIdRecepMat = ?
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS recepcionCapturada FROM tReintegroRecepcionEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioReintegro = ? AND cIdContrato = ? AND cIdRecepcion = ?

SELECT CASE WHEN ( mRemanenteAnticipo > 0 AND mRemanenteAnticipo <= ? ) THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS tieneRemanente , CONVERT(DECIMAL(17, 2), totalPagoAnticipo) as totalPagosAnticipo FROM v_pago_diverso_anticipo WHERE cIdContrato = ?
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS boletosCapturados FROM tReintegroBoletajeAvion WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioReintegro = ?

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS esProveedorVuelos , PAGO.caNoContrarrecibo cxp FROM tPAGODIVERSOEncabezado PAGO WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tReintegroDetalle REINT WITH (NOLOCK) ON PAGO.caNoContrarrecibo = REINT.cxp WHERE nFolioReintegro = ? AND PAGO.RFC in (select RFC from tproveedorBoletos) GROUP BY PAGO.caNoContrarrecibo
SELECT cnombreconciliacion, nidconciliacion FROM tcattipoconciliacioncont WITH(nolock) ORDER BY nidconciliacion
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS esProvBoletaje FROM tCat_ProveedorBoletajeAvion WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cTipoPago = ? AND RFC = LTRIM(RTRIM(?)) AND bActivo = 1
select COUNT(*) as esAdminRecMat from cg_usuario_role WITH(NOLOCK) where U_LOGIN=? AND R_NOMBRE = 'ADMIN_RECMAT'
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS capturaLayoutVuelos FROM tTempVuelosEnCaptura WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioPago = ?
SELECT nClaveCNA AS nclavecna FROM tCatalogoEP ep WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ep.EP = ?
SELECT MIN(nMes) AS nMesIni, MAX(nMes) AS nMesFin FROM dbo.tRegistroIngresoDetalle WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EP = ? AND nFolioRegistroIngreso = ?
SELECT mImporte AS mImporteMes FROM dbo.tRegistroIngresoDetalle WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EP = ? AND nFolioRegistroIngreso = ? AND nMes = ?
SELECT MIN(nMes) AS nMesIni, MAX(nMes) AS nMesFin FROM vSaldosRadicadoxMes WHERE EP = ? AND Folio = ?
SELECT mImporte AS mImporteMes FROM vSaldosRadicadoxMes (NOLOCK) WHERE EP = ? AND Folio = ? AND nMes = ?
SELECT CAST(ISNULL(nFolioIngresoPago,0) as VARCHAR(10)) AS nExisteIngresoPago FROM dbo.tIngresoPagoEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioSolicitud = ? AND cTipoSolicitud = ? AND cRadicado = ?

SELECT CASE COUNT(*) WHEN 1 THEN 'Verdadero' ELSE 'Falso' END AS EpUsada FROM dbo.tIngresoPagoEncabezado e (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.tIngresoPagoDetalle d (NOLOCK) ON e.nFolioIngresoPago = d.nFolioIngresoPago WHERE nFolioSolicitud = ? AND cTipoSolicitud = ? AND EP = ?
SELECT ISNULL(mTotal,0) AS mTotalIngresoPago FROM dbo.tIngresoPagoEncabezado e (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioIngresoPago = ?

SELECT '- Seleccionar -' TIPO_CONCEPTO, '' ID_TIPO_CONCEPTO UNION select t.TIPO_CONCEPTO, t.ID_TIPO_CONCEPTO FROM CAT_TIPO_CONCEPTO t WITH(NOLOCK) , tTipoConceptoDestino d WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE t.ID_TIPO_CONCEPTO = d.ID_TIPO_CONCEPTO and d.ID_DESTINO_GASTO = ? AND t.ID_TIPO_CONCEPTO NOT IN (CASE WHEN (d.ID_DESTINO_GASTO = ? AND '10' <> ? ) THEN 'AL' ELSE '' END)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS boletosExistentes FROM tInfoBoleto WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioRelacionGastos = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) esViaticos FROM tRELACIONGASTOSDetalle WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE substring(OBGT,1,2) = '37' AND nFolioRELACIONGASTOS = ?
SELECT CASE WHEN ( ( SUBSTRING(?, 57, 3) Between 'E04' AND 'E09') OR ( SUBSTRING(?, 61, 3) Between 'E04' AND 'E09') ) THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS esEPCECFOR

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(cRadicado) > 0 THEN '1' WHEN ( SELECT isRadicado FROM pContratoDiverso WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cIdContrato = ? ) = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS tieneCOMPRadicado FROM tCOMPROMISOEncabezado COMPROMISOENC WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tCompromisoDetalle COMPROMISODET WITH (NOLOCK) ON ( COMPROMISODET.nFolioCompromiso = COMPROMISOENC.nFolioCompromiso ) WHERE COMPROMISOENC.cIdContrato = ? AND COMPROMISOENC.cRadicado = 'S' AND COMPROMISOENC.cDocumentoHaplicado = 'S' AND COMPROMISODET.EP = ?

Select '- Seleccionar -' Folio , '' Importe UNION SELECT DISTINCT CAST( Folio as VARCHAR(20)) Folio, CASE CAST( ? AS INT) WHEN 1 THEN MontoEnero WHEN 2 THEN MontoFebrero WHEN 3 THEN MontoMarzo WHEN 4 THEN MontoAbril WHEN 5 THEN MontoMayo WHEN 6 THEN MontoJunio WHEN 7 THEN MontoJulio WHEN 8 THEN MontoAgosto WHEN 9 THEN MontoSeptiembre WHEN 10 THEN MontoOctubre WHEN 11 THEN MontoNoviembre WHEN 12 THEN MontoDiciembre END Importe FROM dbo.vSaldosRadicado WHERE Ep = ? AND CASE CAST( ? AS INT) WHEN 1 THEN MontoEnero WHEN 2 THEN MontoFebrero WHEN 3 THEN MontoMarzo WHEN 4 THEN MontoAbril WHEN 5 THEN MontoMayo WHEN 6 THEN MontoJunio WHEN 7 THEN MontoJulio WHEN 8 THEN MontoAgosto WHEN 9 THEN MontoSeptiembre WHEN 10 THEN MontoOctubre WHEN 11 THEN MontoNoviembre WHEN 12 THEN MontoDiciembre END > 0

SELECT CASE ? WHEN 'PAGOOBRA' THEN (SELECT o.cRadicado FROM dbo.tPAGOOBRAEncabezado o (NOLOCK) WHERE o.nFolioPAGOOBRA = CAST(RIGHT(?,CHARINDEX('-', REVERSE(?))-1) AS INT)) WHEN 'PAGODIVERSO' THEN (SELECT d.cRadicado FROM dbo.tPAGODIVERSOEncabezado d (NOLOCK) WHERE d.nFolioPAGODIVERSO = CAST(RIGHT(?,CHARINDEX('-', REVERSE(?))-1) AS INT) ) WHEN 'RELACIONGASTOS' THEN (SELECT rg.cRadicado FROM dbo.tRELACIONGASTOSEncabezado rg (NOLOCK) WHERE rg.nFolioRELACIONGASTOS = CAST(RIGHT(?,CHARINDEX('-', REVERSE(?))-1) AS INT) ) END AS cEsRadicado
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END AS conCompromiso FROM vRadicadoConCompromiso WHERE nIdIntegracion = ?
SELECT CASE WHEN sFirmanteAut <> '' THEN 'SIEXISTE' ELSE 'NOEXISTE' END AS existeFirmante FROM tAnexo1Encabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioAnexo1 = ?
SELECT CASE WHEN esIngresosPropios = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS esIngresoPropio FROM tCatalogo_Reintegros WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ID_REINTEGRO = ?

SELECT (CASE cTipoPago WHEN 'RELACIONGASTOS' THEN (SELECT rg.cRadicado FROM dbo.tRELACIONGASTOSEncabezado rg (NOLOCK) WHERE rg.nFolioRELACIONGASTOS = p.nFolioPago) WHEN 'PAGODIVERSO' THEN (SELECT pd.cRadicado FROM dbo.tPAGODIVERSOEncabezado pd (NOLOCK) WHERE pd.nFolioPAGODIVERSO = p.nFolioPago) WHEN 'PAGOOBRA' THEN (SELECT po.cRadicado FROM dbo.tPAGOOBRAEncabezado po (NOLOCK) WHERE po.nFolioPAGOOBRA = p.nFolioPago) END ) AS Radicado FROM dbo.tPagadoEncabezado p WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE p.caNoContrarrecibo = ?

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(nEstatus) > 0 THEN (SELECT (CASE WHEN nEstatus = 0 THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END) FROM dbo.tConciliacion (NOLOCK) WHERE nConciliacion = ? AND nFinal = 0) ELSE 'N' END AS seImporto FROM dbo.tConciliacion (NOLOCK) WHERE nConciliacion = ? AND nFinal = 0

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(nEstatus) > 0 THEN (SELECT (CASE WHEN nEstatus = 0 THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END) FROM dbo.tConciliacionFFM (NOLOCK) WHERE nConciliacion = ? AND nFinal = 0) ELSE 'N' END AS seImporto FROM dbo.tConciliacionFFM (NOLOCK) WHERE nConciliacion = ? AND nFinal = 0

SELECT pago.cFolioOficio AS cFolioOficioVoBo, CONVERT( VARCHAR(12), pago.dFechaOficio, 103) AS dFechaOficioVoBo, ISNULL(pago.cNombreTitular, emp.NOMBREN) AS cNombreTitularVoBo, ISNULL(pago.cApellidoPaternoTitular, emp.NOMBREP) AS cPaternoTitularVoBo, ISNULL(pago.cApellidoMaternoTitular, emp.NOMBREM) AS cMaternoTitularVoBo, ISNULL(pago.cPuestoTitular, emp.CARGO) AS cPuestoTitularVoBo, pago.cNumeroEmpleado AS cboSuplenteVoBo, 'Existe' AS firmanteOficioVoBoExiste, pago.cNumeroEmpleado AS cboSuplenteVoBo FROM tPagoFirmanteDelegatorioVoBo pago WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN v_empleados_giro emp WITH (NOLOCK) ON emp.clave = pago.cNumeroEmpleado WHERE pago.cTipoPago = ? AND pago.nFolioPago = ?

SELECT cFolioOficio AS cFolioOficioVoBo, dFechaOficio AS dFechaOficioVoBo, cNombreTitular AS cNombreTitularVoBo, cApellidoPaternoTitular AS cPaternoTitularVoBo, cApellidoMaternoTitular AS cMaternoTitularVoBo, cPuestoTitular AS cPuestoTitularVoBo, 'Existe' AS firmanteOficioVoBoExiste, cNumeroEmpleado AS cboSuplenteVoBo FROM tPagoFirmanteDelegatorioVoBo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cTipoPago = ? AND nFolioPago = ?
SELECT CASE cTipoPago WHEN 'AJENAS' then '1' ELSE '0' END AS esAjena FROM tPagadoEncabezado WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioSICOP = ? AND caNoContrarrecibo = ?

SELECT '--Seleccionar--' as caNoContrarrecibo, '' AS contrarrecibo UNION SELECT DISTINCT D.caNoContrarrecibo, D.caNoContrarrecibo AS contrarrecibo FROM tOperAjenasEncabezado E WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tOperAjenasDetalle D WITH (NOLOCK) ON ( D.nFolioOperAjenas = E.nFolioOperAjenas ) WHERE E.caNoContrarrecibo = ? ORDER BY contrarrecibo, caNoContrarrecibo
SELECT '-- Seleccionar --' as cPartida, '' AS Partida UNION SELECT cPartida, cPartida AS Partida FROM tCat_TipoPartidas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cTipoPartida = 'Boletaje'
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS existeFolio FROM tComisionesSinComprobacionEnc WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioComision = ?

SELECT DISTINCT nIdComision, cConcepto_Comision, fInicio, fFin, RFC as cRFC, Beneficiario AS cNOMRFC, cInformeComision, nAcompanantes, lBoletoVigente, cEsFirmaElectronica cEsFIEL FROM vw_ComisionesSinComprobacion WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioComision = ?
SELECT ISNULL(Sum(mimporteiva), 0) AS mImporteIVA FROM tPagoFactura WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioPago = ? AND cTipoPago = ?

SELECT CASE WHEN ( SELECT ISNULL( SUM( mImporteIngresoPropio ), 0 ) AS mImporteIngresoPropio FROM( SELECT SUM(DET.mImporte) AS mImporteIngresoPropio FROM tRegistroIngresoEncabezado ENC WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tRegistroIngresoDetalle DET WITH (NOLOCK) ON ( DET.nFolioRegistroIngreso = ENC.nFolioRegistroIngreso ) WHERE ENC.nTipoIngreso = 2 AND ENC.cDocumentoHaplicado = 'S' UNION ALL SELECT -SUM(mImportemasIva) AS mImporteIngresoPropio FROM tDisminucionDevEncabezado enc WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tDisminucionDevDetalle det WITH (NOLOCK) on enc.nFolioDisminucionDev = det.nFolioDisminucionDev WHERE enc.cDocumentoHaplicado ='S' and SUBSTRING( det.ep, 40,1) = 4 AND SUBSTRING(DET.EP, 61, 3) NOT IN (SELECT cUnidadNormativa FROM tCatUnidadNormativaGreenMex WITH (NOLOCK)) UNION ALL SELECT ISNULL( sum(rd.mImporte),0) as mImporteIngresoPropio FROM tReintegroAutDetalle rd INNER JOIN tReintegroAutEncabezado re ON rd.nFolioReintegroaut = re.nFolioReintegroaut WHERE rd.cxp IN ( SELECT caNoContrarrecibo FROM tRELACIONGASTOSEncabezado enc INNER JOIN tRELACIONGASTOSDetalle det on enc.nFolioRELACIONGASTOS = det.nFolioRELACIONGASTOS WHERE substring(det.ep,40,1) = 4 AND enc.cDocumentoHaplicado = 's' AND SUBSTRING(DET.EP, 61, 3) NOT IN (SELECT cUnidadNormativa FROM tCatUnidadNormativaGreenMex WITH (NOLOCK)) group by caNoContrarrecibo UNION SELECT caNoContrarrecibo FROM tPAGODIVERSOEncabezado enc INNER JOIN tPAGODIVERSODetalle det on enc.nFolioPAGODIVERSO = det.nFolioPAGODIVERSO WHERE substring(det.ep,40,1) = 4 AND enc.cDocumentoHaplicado = 's' AND SUBSTRING(DET.EP, 61, 3) NOT IN (SELECT cUnidadNormativa FROM tCatUnidadNormativaGreenMex WITH (NOLOCK)) group by caNoContrarrecibo ) ) AS ingreso ) < ( SELECT ISNULL((SUM(T.ImportePagos) + ?), 0) AS mImportePagosIngPropio FROM ( SELECT ISNULL(SUM(DET.mImporteMasIva), 0) AS ImportePagos FROM tRELACIONGASTOSEncabezado ENC WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tRELACIONGASTOSDetalle DET WITH (NOLOCK) ON ( DET.nFolioRELACIONGASTOS = ENC.nFolioRELACIONGASTOS ) WHERE ( ENC.cDocumentoHaplicado = 'S' OR ENC.cDocumentoHaplicado IS NULL ) AND SUBSTRING(DET.EP, 40, 1) = '4' AND SUBSTRING(DET.EP, 61, 3) NOT IN (SELECT cUnidadNormativa FROM tCatUnidadNormativaGreenMex WITH (NOLOCK)) UNION SELECT ISNULL(SUM(DET.mImporteMasIva), 0) AS ImportePagos FROM tPAGODIVERSOEncabezado ENC WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tPAGODIVERSODetalle DET WITH (NOLOCK) ON ( DET.nFolioPAGODIVERSO = ENC.nFolioPAGODIVERSO ) WHERE ENC.cEsRelacionGastos = 'S' AND ( ENC.cDocumentoHaplicado = 'S' OR ENC.cDocumentoHaplicado IS NULL ) AND SUBSTRING(DET.EP, 40, 1) = '4' AND SUBSTRING(DET.EP, 61, 3) NOT IN (SELECT cUnidadNormativa FROM tCatUnidadNormativaGreenMex WITH (NOLOCK)) ) AS T ) THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS nValidaSuficienciaIP

SELECT DISTINCT TOP 1 ISNULL(NCLC_43,'') AS nFolioSICOP, ISNULL(NCTR_47,'') AS caNoContrarrecibo, ISNULL(FOLIO_SIAFF_112,'') AS nFolioSIAFF, 'Rectificacion del Ingreso Fiscal de ' + NCTR_47 AS cDescripcionPoliza FROM CLC_SICOP WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE NCTR_47 = ?
SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), fExp, 103) fExp, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), fAplicacion, 103) AS fApl FROM tRectificacionIngresosEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioRectificaIngreso = ?
SELECT CASE WHEN sFirmanteAut IS NULL THEN 'NOEXISTE' ELSE 'SIEXISTE' END existeFirmante FROM tRectificacionIngresosEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioRectificaIngreso = ?

SELECT caNoContrarreciboInt, caNoContrarrecibo AS cxpAjuste, CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),mAjuste,13) AS mImporteAjuste, CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),(mImporteNeto + mAjuste),13) AS mImporteInt, CONVERT(VARCHAR(64), mImporteNeto, 13) AS mImporteconAjuste FROM tPagoPenasConvIntegradoEnc enc WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tPagoPenasConvIntegradoDet det WITH (NOLOCK) ON ( enc.nFolioPagoPenasConvInt = det.nFolioPagoPenasConvInt ) WHERE mAjuste > 0 AND enc.nFolioPagoPenasConvInt = ?

SELECT enc.fAplicacion, enc.caNoContrarrecibo, enc.cDescripcionPoliza cConcepto , cTipopago cTipoPago, det.caNoContrarrecibo cxpPago, det.nFolioPago nFolioPago, RFC, pagos.cUnidadResponsable urPago , cnombre beneficiarioPago, mImporteTotal importeBrutoPago, mImporteRetencion importeImpuestosPago, mImporteNeto importeTotalPago , SUM(det.mPenalizacion) AS mImportePenalizacionPago , cconcepto cConceptoPago, pagos.fAplicacion fAplicacionPago FROM tPagoPenasConvEncabezado enc WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tPagoPenasConvDetalle det WITH (NOLOCK) ON enc.nFolioPagoPenasConv = det.nFolioPagoPenasConv INNER JOIN vMultilistadorPagos pagos WITH (NOLOCK) ON det.caNoContrarrecibo = pagos.caNoContrarrecibo WHERE enc.nFolioPagoPenasConv = ? GROUP BY enc.fAplicacion, enc.caNoContrarrecibo, enc.cDescripcionPoliza , cTipopago, det.caNoContrarrecibo, det.nFolioPago, RFC, pagos.cUnidadResponsable , cnombre, mImporteTotal, mImporteRetencion, mImporteNeto , cconcepto, pagos.fAplicacion
SELECT ISNULL(clineaCaptura,'') AS cLineaCaptura FROM tPagoPenasConvIntegradoEnc WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioPagoPenasConvInt = ?

SELECT CASE WHEN fCancelacion IS NOT NULL THEN 'Cancelada' WHEN cDocumentoHaplicado = 'S' THEN 'SI' ELSE 'NO' END AS validaPagadoPCI FROM tPagoPenasConvIntegradoEnc WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioPagoPenasConvInt = ?
SELECT ISNULL(clineaCaptura,'') AS cLineaCaptura FROM tPagoPenasConvIntegradoEnc WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioPagoPenasConvInt = ?
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS existePenaInt FROM tPagoPenasConvIntegradoEnc WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioPagoPenasConvInt = ?
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS existeOAInt FROM tOperAjenasIntegradoEnc WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioOperAjenasInt = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pasivoCapturado FROM tDocPolizaEncabezado WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nMes = ? AND esPasivoPatrimonial = 1 AND cDocumentoHAplicado = 'S'
SELECT Isnull(Sum(mtotal), 0) AS totalAgregado FROM vw_ttempvuelosencaptura WITH(nolock) WHERE ctipopago = ? AND nfoliopago = ?

SELECT SUM(vuelosdet.mTotal) AS mImporteVuelos FROM tLayoutVuelosDet vuelosdet WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tTempVuelosEnCaptura captura WITH (NOLOCK) ON ( captura.nFolioVuelos = vuelosdet.nFolioVuelos AND captura.nDocRenglon = vuelosdet.nDocRenglon ) WHERE captura.cTipoPago = ? AND captura.nFolioPago = ?
SELECT '- Seleccionar -' descProyecto, '' tipoProyecto UNION select dFonden, cFonden FROM dbo.tCatalogoFonden ORDER BY 2
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nFondenCapturado FROM tPAGODIVERSOEncabezado WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioPAGODIVERSO = ? AND (cproyectoFonden IS NOT NULL OR cProyectoFonden <> '' )

SELECT cFonden + '-' + dFonden AS proyectoFondenRead FROM tPAGODIVERSOEncabezado encabezado WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tCatalogoFonden catalogo WITH(NOLOCK) ON encabezado.cProyectoFonden = catalogo.cFonden WHERE nFolioPAGODIVERSO = ?

SELECT 'TODAS LAS UNIDADES' AS D_DESCRIPCION, '*' AS cUnidadResponsable UNION SELECT cUnidadResponsable + ' - ' + D_DESCRIPCION D_DESCRIPCION, cUnidadResponsable FROM tCatUnidadResponsable WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nAlcance = 1
SELECT 'Todas las Aerolineas' AS cDescripcionTipo, '0' AS nIDTipoAerolinea UNION SELECT cDescripcionTipo, nIDTipoAerolinea FROM tCatTipoAerolinea ORDER BY 2
SELECT COUNT(*) AS contador FROM dbo.tpasivosContingentesNotaM WHERE idPasivoContingente = ? AND cMes = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) AS contador FROM dbo.tpasivosContingentesNotaT WHERE cTrimestre = ?

SELECT top 1 case when SUBSTRING(EP,32,1) = '2' THEN 'Compromiso para cubrir los gastos de caja chica del personal de la Conafor a nivel nacional' when SUBSTRING(EP,32,1) = '3' THEN 'Compromiso para cubrir los gastos en comisiones y revolvencia de caja chica del personal de la Conafor a nivel nacional' end conceptoContrato FROM tCompromisoDetalle WHERE nFolioCompromiso=? order by SUBSTRING(EP,32,1)

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tCompromisoEncabezado com WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tLayoutsCreadosRelacionGastosHeader l WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.sAuxiliarComodin = com.cIdContrato INNER JOIN tRelacionGastosEncabezado rg WITH (NOLOCK) ON rg.caNoContrarrecibo = l.sNoContrarrecibo WHERE com.caNoCompromiso = ? AND ( rg.ID_DESTINO_GASTO IN ('CPRP') OR (rg.CTAB = 'Pago_Referenciado' AND rg.ID_DESTINO_GASTO NOT IN ('2NRQ')) ) AND rg.cDocumentoHaplicado = 'S' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS integradaRef

SELECT TOP 1 CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(EP, 40,1) <> 4 THEN SUBSTRING(EP, 40,1) ELSE SUBSTRING(EP, 40,1) END AS PagoEsIP FROM tpagadoencabezado AS PE WITH(nolock) JOIN tpagadodetalle AS PD WITH(NOLOCK) ON PE.nFolioPagado = PD.nFolioPagado WHERE nfoliosicop = ? AND canocontrarrecibo = ?
SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING(EP, 40,1) AS PagoEsIP FROM tpagadoencabezado AS PE WITH(nolock) JOIN tpagadodetalle AS PD WITH(NOLOCK) ON PE.nFolioPagado = PD.nFolioPagado WHERE canocontrarrecibo = ?

SELECT ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN '0' ELSE '1' END FROM vContratoEPs WHERE cidcontrato = ? AND SUBSTRING(ep, 32, 5) <> '43301' ) AS partidaFed, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '0' ELSE '1' END FROM vContratoEPs WHERE cidcontrato = ? AND SUBSTRING(ep, 32, 5) = '43301' ) AS partidaFedCombinado

SELECT CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM ( ISNULL(mCompromisoEnero, 0) + ISNULL(mCompromisoFebrero, 0) + ISNULL(mCompromisoMarzo, 0) + ISNULL(mCompromisoAbril, 0) + ISNULL(mCompromisoMayo, 0) + ISNULL(mCompromisoJunio, 0) + ISNULL(mCompromisoJulio, 0) + ISNULL(mCompromisoAgosto, 0) + ISNULL(mCompromisoSeptiembre, 0) + ISNULL(mCompromisoOctubre, 0) + ISNULL(mCompromisoNoviembre, 0) + ISNULL(mCompromisoDiciembre, 0) ) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) ELSE 0.00 END ) AS mComprometidoFiscal FROM vw_CompromisosContratosRemanente WHERE cidcontrato = ? AND SUBSTRING(EP, 40, 1) <> '4'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS contador FROM dbo.tpasivosContingentesLaborales WHERE idPasivoContingente = ? AND cMes = ?
SELECT MAX( CONVERT(INT, ISNULL(cFolio, 0) ) ) + 1 AS cfdiFolio FROM tSerieFolio WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE cSerie = ?

SELECT nFolioPAGODIVERSO, caNoContrarrecibo, cFolioPAGODIVERSO AS cIdpedContDef, cIdRecepMat FROM tPAGODIVERSOEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE caNoContrarrecibo = (SELECT TOP 1 cxp FROM tReintegroDetalle WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioReintegro = ? )

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS isAdmin FROM CG_USUARIO_ROLE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE U_LOGIN = ? AND R_NOMBRE IN ( 'ADMIN_RECMAT', 'ANALISTA','LAYOUT_COMPROMISO_ADMIN', 'LAYOUT_COMPROMISO_CALENDARIO')

SELECT CASE WHEN Count(*) > 0 THEN 'NO' ELSE 'SI' END AS esPagoLayoutBan FROM trelaciongastosdetalle WITH (nolock) WHERE nfoliorelaciongastos IN(SELECT nfoliorelaciongastos FROM trelaciongastoscompromisoencabezado rgCompromisoEnc WITH(nolock) INNER JOIN trelaciongastoscompromisodetalle rgCompromisoDet WITH(nolock) ON rgCompromisoEnc.nfoliorelaciongastoscompromiso = rgCompromisoDet.nfoliorelaciongastoscompromiso WHERE canocontrarrecibo = ?) AND Substring(cevento, 5, 20) IN (SELECT cevento FROM tcat_eventossinlayoutbancario WITH (nolock) )
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS existeFolio FROM tContratosPlurianualEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioContratoPlurianual = ?
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS existeFolio FROM tContratosPlurianualEnc_Mod WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioContratoPlurianual = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) tab_calendario FROM CG_USUARIO_ROLE with (NOLOCK) WHERE R_NOMBRE = 'LAYOUT_COMPROMISO_CALENDARIO' AND U_LOGIN = ?

SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), fInicio, 103) AS fInicio, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), fFin, 103) AS fFin, nTipoContrato, nSolicitud, nEspecificacion, cEstatus, cJustifSolicitud cJustificaSolicitud, mMontoMinimo, mMontoMaximo, mMontoTotalContrato mTotalContrato, cFundamentoMotivacion, cEspecificacion, cJustificacionEconomica, cJustificacionPlazo, cFolioMASCP AS folioMASCP, cDescripcionProyecto AS cDescProyecto, cOficioDG AS oficioDG , nfolioContratoOrigen nFolioContratoPlurianual FROM tContratosPlurianualEnc_Mod WITH (NOLOCK) where nFolioContratoPlurianual = ?

SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), fInicio, 103) AS fInicio, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), fFin, 103) AS fFin, nTipoContrato, nSolicitud, nEspecificacion, cEstatus, cJustifSolicitud cJustificaSolicitud, CONVERT(VARCHAR, mMontoMinimo, 1) mMontoMinimo, CONVERT(VARCHAR, mMontoMaximo, 1) mMontoMaximo, CONVERT(VARCHAR, mMontoTotalContrato, 1) mTotalContrato, cFundamentoMotivacion, cEspecificacion, cJustificacionEconomica, cJustificacionPlazo, cFolioMASCP AS folioMASCP, cDescripcionProyecto AS cDescProyecto, cOficioDG AS oficioDG FROM tContratosPlurianualEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) where nFolioContratoPlurianual = ?
SELECT count(*) cEsModificado FROM tContratosPlurianualEnc_Mod WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioContratoOrigen = ? AND nFolioContratoPlurianual != ?
select MAX(nFolioContratoPlurianual) nFolioUltimo from tContratosPlurianualEnc_Mod where nFolioContratoOrigen = ?
select MAX(nFolioContratoPlurianual) folioAnterior from tContratosPlurianualEnc_Mod where nFolioContratoOrigen = ? and nFolioContratoPlurianual <> ?

SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), fInicio, 103) AS fInicio, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), fFin, 103) AS fFin, nTipoContrato, nSolicitud, nEspecificacion, cEstatus, cJustifSolicitud cJustificaSolicitud, MontoMinimo AS mMontoMinimo, MontoMaximo AS mMontoMaximo, TotalContrato AS mTotalContrato, cFundamentoMotivacion, cEspecificacion, cJustificacionEconomica, cJustificacionPlazo, cFolioMASCP AS folioMASCP, cDescripcionProyecto AS cDescProyecto, cOficioDG AS oficioDG , compJustificacion cJustificacion, cFundamentoMotivacion cFundamentoMotiv FROM vw_ContratosPlurianualEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE Folio = ?

select CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), fInicio, 103) AS fInicio, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), fFin, 103) AS fFin, nTipoContrato, nSolicitud, nEspecificacion, cEstatus, cJustifSolicitud cJustificaSolicitud, mMontoMinimo, mMontoMaximo, mMontoTotalContrato AS mTotalContrato, cFundamentoMotivacion, cEspecificacion, cJustificacionEconomica, cJustificacionPlazo, cFolioMASCP AS folioMASCP, cDescripcionProyecto AS cDescProyecto, cOficioDG AS oficioDG , (SELECT mensaje cJustificacion FROM tcat_mensajes where nombre = 'PLURI_JUST' AND YEAR(FINICIO) = nAnio) cJustificacion , cFundamentoMotivacion cFundamentoMotiv FROM tContratosPlurianualEnc_Mod WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioContratoPlurianual = ?
SELECT aEjercicio aEjercicioBorrar FROM tContratosPlurianual_MontosEjercicios WHERE nDocRenglon = ? AND nFolioContratoPlurianual = ?
SELECT aEjercicio aEjercicioBorrar FROM tContratosPlurianual_EjercicioMod WHERE nDocRenglon = ? AND nFolioContratoPlurianual = ?
SELECT MAX(ndocRenglon) + 1 renglon FROM tContratosPlurianual_MontosEjercicios WHERE nFolioContratoPlurianual = ?
SELECT MAX(ndocRenglon) + 1 renglon FROM tContratosPlurianual_EjercicioMod WHERE nFolioContratoPlurianual = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pasivoCapturado FROM tDocPolizaEncabezado WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nMes = ? AND esPasivoLaboral = 1 AND cDocumentoHAplicado = 'S'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pasivoCapturado FROM tpasivosContingentesLaborales WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE cMes = ?

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS tienePagoPendiente FROM tPAGODIVERSOEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cFolioPAGODIVERSO = ? AND ISNULL(cDocumentoHaplicado, 'S') = 'S' AND ISNULL(nEnviadoSICOP, 0) IN (0, 2) AND cIngresosPropios <> 'S'

SELECT STUFF ( ( SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + CASE WHEN RTRIM(LTRIM(caNoContrarrecibo)) = '0' THEN CAST(nFolioPAGODIVERSO AS VARCHAR) ELSE RTRIM(LTRIM(ISNULL(caNoContrarrecibo, nFolioPAGODIVERSO))) END FROM tPAGODIVERSOEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cFolioPAGODIVERSO = ? AND ISNULL(cDocumentoHaplicado, 'S') = 'S' AND ISNULL(nEnviadoSICOP, 0) IN (0, 2) FOR xml path('') ), 1, 1, '' ) AS pagoCXP

SELECT cIdSolicitud + ' $'+CAST(CAST(mImporteNeto AS MONEY) AS VARCHAR(50)) AS SolicitudDesc, cIdSolicitud AS IdSolicitud FROM v_SolicitudesDirectas WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE cIdUnidadEjecutora = ? UNION SELECT 'Seleccione una opcion', '-1' ORDER BY 2
SELECT mImportebruto AS mImporteBrutoSol, mImporteIVA AS mImporteIVASol, mImporteNeto AS mImporteNetoSol FROM v_SolicitudesDirectas WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE cIdSolicitud = ?
SELECT cTipoSuplencia, nTipoSuplencia FROM tCatTipoSuplencia WITH(NOLOCK)
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS existeFolioRI FROM tRegistroIngresoEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioRegistroIngreso = ?
SELECT cDocumentoHaplicado FROM tRegistroIngresoEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioRegistroIngreso = ?
SELECT CASE WHEN sFirmanteAut IS NULL THEN 'NOEXISTE' ELSE 'SIEXISTE' END existeFirmante FROM tReintegroIngresoEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioReintegroIngreso = ?
SELECT DISTINCT 'R_' + cEvento AS cEvento FROM tRegistroIngresoDetalle WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioRegistroIngreso = ?

SELECT TOP 1 CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(enc.cIdContrato, 1, 2) = 'PE' THEN '0' WHEN SUBSTRING(det.EP, 40, 1) = '4' THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS aplicaPreComp FROM tCompromisoEncabezado enc WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tCompromisoDetalle det WITH (NOLOCK) ON (det.nFolioCompromiso = enc.nFolioCompromiso) WHERE enc.nFolioCompromiso = ? ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(enc.cIdContrato, 1, 2) = 'PE' THEN '0' WHEN SUBSTRING(det.EP, 40, 1) = '4' THEN '0' ELSE '1' END DESC

SELECT pago.nFolioPagoDirecto ,ID_DESTINO_GASTO, ID_TIPO_CONCEPTO, ID_TIPO_MOVIMIENTO , cIdRFC, CTAB, NOMBRE, pago.mImporteBruto , mImporteRetencion, mImporteNeto , SUM(factura.mImporteIVA) mImporteIVA , SUM(factura.mImporteDescuento) mImporteDescuento , SUM(factura.mimporteconiva) mImporteFacturas , cConcepto , caNoContrarrecibo , fFechaInicio, fFechaFin , mImporteRetencion , cIdTipoPagoDirecto , ben.CBEN, ben.cIdTipoPersonaRFC , iva.DESCRIPCION_20 FROM dbo.tPagoDirectoEncabezado pago (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.tPagoDirectoPAAS paas (NOLOCK) ON pago.nFolioPagoDirecto = paas.nFolioPagoDirecto INNER JOIN dbo.tPagoFactura factura (NOLOCK) ON pago.nFolioPagoDirecto = factura.nFolioPago AND factura.cTipoPago = 'PAGODIRECTO' INNER JOIN dbo.tBeneficiario ben ON ben.dRFC = pago.cIdRFC INNER JOIN dbo.CAT_TIPO_IVA iva ON (pago.nPorcIVA * 100) = iva.valor WHERE pago.nFolioPagoDirecto = ? GROUP BY pago.nFolioPagoDirecto ,ID_DESTINO_GASTO, ID_TIPO_CONCEPTO, ID_TIPO_MOVIMIENTO , cIdRFC, CTAB, NOMBRE, pago.mImporteBruto, mImporteRetencion, mImporteNeto, cConcepto, cIdTipoDocumento , fFechaInicio, fFechaFin , caNoContrarrecibo, mImporteRetencion, cIdTipoPagoDirecto , CBEN, ben.cIdTipoPersonaRFC, iva.DESCRIPCION_20

SELECT nFolioPagoDirecto , SUM(mImporteIvaArrenda +mImporteIvaHonorarios) mIVA , SUM(mISRArrenda + mISRHonorarios + mISROtros + mImporteISRLaudos) mISR , SUM(mImporteFlete23 + mImporteFlete4) mFletes , SUM (mImporteObra+ mObra5 ) mMillar5 , SUM(m2Millar) mMillar2 , SUM( mRetImpuestoCedular + mOtrosImpuestos) mOtrosImpuestos , SUM (mPenalizacion) mImportePenalizacion , SUM(mCNIC) mCNIC FROM dbo.tPagoDirectoDetalle WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioPagoDirecto = ? GROUP BY nFolioPagoDirecto
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS mostrarRefInfonacot FROM tCat_RFCInfonacot WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE RFC = ? AND nActivo = 1
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS editaMontoRFC FROM tCatRFC_EditaMontos WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cModulo = ? AND RFC = ? AND bActivo = 1
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS esLayoutRGActiva FROM tLayoutsCreadosRelacionGastosHeader WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sAuxiliarComodin = ? AND cEstatus = 'ACTIVO'

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS tieneLayout FROM tLayoutsCreadosHeader layout WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tPagoDirectoEncabezado pago WITH (NOLOCK) ON pago.caNoContrarrecibo = layout.sNoContrarrecibo WHERE pago.cDocumentoHaplicado = 'S' and nEnviadoSICOP = 1 AND layout.sNoContrarrecibo = ?
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS esConsolidaAplicada FROM tCONSOLIDACIONRGENCABEZADO WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nIdIntegracion = ? AND cDocumentoHaplicado = 'S'

SELECT STUFF ( ( SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + enc.caNoContrarrecibo FROM tRELACIONGASTOSEncabezado enc WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tRELACIONGASTOSDetalle det WITH (NOLOCK) ON ( det.nFolioRELACIONGASTOS = enc.nFolioRELACIONGASTOS ) WHERE enc.nFolioRELACIONGASTOS IN ( SELECT nFolioRelacionGastos FROM tRelacionGastosCompromisoEncabezado rgCompromisoEnc WITH(nolock) INNER JOIN tRelacionGastosCompromisoDetalle rgCompromisoDet WITH(nolock) ON rgCompromisoEnc.nFolioRelacionGastosCompromiso = rgCompromisoDet.nFolioRelacionGastosCompromiso WHERE canocontrarrecibo = ? ) AND Substring(det.cEvento, 5, 20) IN (SELECT cEvento FROM tCat_EventosSinLayoutBancario WITH (nolock) )
FOR xml path('') ), 1, 1, '' ) AS noAplicaRGLayoutBan

SELECT ( CASE WHEN lpagoconfacturas > 0 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END ) AS esComprobacionConFacturas, ( CASE WHEN loficioextranjero > 0 THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END ) AS esComisionNacional, ( CASE WHEN loficioextranjero > 0 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END ) AS esComisionInternacional, ( CASE WHEN lcertificadotransito > 0 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END ) AS esCertificadoTransito, ( CASE WHEN lalimentacionbrigadistas > 0 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END ) AS esPagoAlimentacion, ( CASE WHEN lnocomprobables > 0 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END ) AS contieneNoComprobable, ( CASE WHEN loficioproveedor > 0 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END ) AS esPagoProveedor FROM trelaciongastostipodocumentacion WITH(nolock) WHERE aejerciciofiscal = ? AND nfoliorelaciongastos = ?
SELECT cfactura AS folioComisionExtranjero, mimporteconiva AS montoComisionExtranjero FROM tpagofactura WITH(nolock) WHERE nfoliopago = ? AND cTipoPago = ? AND crfcfactura = 'EXTRANJERO'
SELECT cfactura AS noCertificado, mimporteconiva AS montoCertificado FROM tpagofactura WITH(nolock) WHERE nfoliopago = ? AND cTipoPago = ? AND crfcfactura = 'OFICIOTRANSITO'
SELECT mmontonocomprobable AS montoNoComprobable FROM trelaciongastosnocomprobable WITH(nolock) WHERE nfoliorelaciongastos = ?
SELECT mimporteconiva AS montoAlimentacion FROM tpagofactura WITH(nolock) WHERE nfoliopago = ? AND cTipoPago = ? AND crfcfactura = 'OFICIOALIMENTACION'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pagoXOficioPermitido FROM tRFCPagoSinFacturaPermitido WHERE cRFC = ? AND cTipoPago = ?
SELECT Count(*) AS nFacturasCapturadas FROM tpagofactura WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nfoliopago = ? AND ctipopago = ? AND cRFCFactura <> 'OFICIOPAGO'
SELECT Count(*) AS nOficioCapturado FROM tpagofactura WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nfoliopago = ? AND ctipopago = ? AND cRFCFactura = 'OFICIOPAGO'

SELECT SUM(mImporteBruto) AS montoBrutoPP, SUM(mimporteiva ) AS montoImpuestosPP, SUM(mImporteBruto) + SUM(mimporteiva ) AS montoNetoPP FROM tPagoFactura factura WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioPago = ? AND cTipoPago = ?
SELECT cDestinoGasto AS destinoGastoElegido FROM tRelacionGastosTipoDocumentacion WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioRelacionGastos = ?
SELECT convert( VARCHAR(32), SUM(mImporteRetencion), 103) AS retencionesFacturas FROM tPagoFacturaRetencion WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cTipoPago = ? AND nFolioPago = ?

SELECT 'Seleccione' AS tipoRetencion , 0 AS cIdTipoRetencion UNION SELECT cTipoRetencion AS tipoRetencion ,cIdTipoRetencion FROM pCatalogoTipoRetencion WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE cIdTipoRetencion NOT IN ( SELECT cIdTipoRetencion FROM tPagoDirectoRetencion WHERE nFolioPagoDirecto = ? ) AND cIdTipoRetencion > 1 ORDER BY cIdTipoRetencion

SELECT cTipoRetencion tipoRetencion, rete.cIdTipoRetencion cIdTipoRetencion FROM pContratoFederalizadoRetencion contrato inner join pCatalogoTipoRetencion rete ON contrato.cIdTipoRetencion = rete.cIdTipoRetencion INNER JOIN tPAGOFEDERALIZADOEncabezado PAGO ON PAGO.cFolioContratoObra = contrato.cIdContrato WHERE nFolioPAGOFEDERALIZADO = ? ORDER BY cIdTipoRetencion
SELECT COUNT(*) AS obligatoria FROM tRelacionPartidaRetencion WHERE partida IN ( SELECT cIdSubPartida FROM tPagoDirectoPAAS WHERE nFolioPagoDirecto = ? ) AND obligatoria = 1

select case when cIdTipoPersonaRFC = 2 then 1 else 0 end AS obligatoria from tPagoFactura fact inner join tBeneficiario ben on fact.cRFCFactura = ben.dRFC where nFolioPago = ? and cTipoPago = ? and fact.cRegimenFiscal = 626
SELECT cTipoRetencion , CAST(ROUND(nPorcRetencion,6,0) AS DECIMAL(18,6)) AS nPorcRetencion FROM pCatalogoTipoRetencion WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cIdTipoRetencion = ?

SELECT nFolioPago AS nFolioPagoRef, CASE WHEN cTipoPago = 'PAGODIRECTO' THEN 'Directo' WHEN cTipoPago = 'PAGOOBRA' THEN 'Obra' WHEN cTipoPago = 'PAGODIVERSO' THEN 'Diverso' WHEN cTipoPago = 'PAGOFEDERALIZADO' THEN 'Federalizado' WHEN cTipoPago = 'RELACIONGASTOS' THEN 'Relacion' WHEN cTipoPago = 'PAGOPENASCONV' THEN 'PenasConv' ELSE '' END AS cTipoPagoRef FROM tPagadoEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE caNoContrarrecibo = ?
SELECT cIdRFC AS RFCRef FROM vMultilistadorPagos WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE docto = ? AND nFolioPago = ?
SELECT cSubcuenta AS cPasivo FROM tpasivosContingentes WHERE cRFC = ? AND (Estatus = 0 OR Estatus IS NULL)
SELECT SUM(mImporteRetencion) AS mImporteRetenPago FROM tpagoFacturaRetencion WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioPago = ? AND cTipoPago = ?
SELECT cUnidadResponsable FROM tCompromisoEncabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioCompromiso = ?

SELECT cIDRFC, cnombre, mImporteTotal, d_descripcion, cTipoContratoDiverso, cTipoAdjudicacion, Case cTCont when 'OB' then 'OBRA' when 'DI' then 'DIVERSO' when 'PD' then 'PDIRECTO' ELSE 'FEDERALIZADO' END AS cTCont, 0 as mComprometido, nPorcIVAAplicable FROM vContratoCompromisoAnual c WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE c.cIdContrato = ? AND c.cIdEntidadContable = ?

SELECT cFonden + '-' + dFonden AS proyectoFondenRead FROM tPAGOOBRAEncabezado pagoObra WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN tCatalogoFonden catalogo WITH(NOLOCK) ON pagoObra.cProyectoFonden = catalogo.cFonden WHERE pagoObra.nFolioPAGOOBRA = ?
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS existeDetPD FROM tPagoDirectoDetalle WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioPagoDirecto = ?

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS tieneCedular FROM pContratoDiversoRetencion r WITH(NOLOCK), pCatalogoTipoRetencion tr WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE tr.cidtiporetencion = r.cidtiporetencion AND CIDCONTRATO = ? AND CIDENTIDADCONTABLE = ? AND tr.cidtiporetencion IN ( 8,9,19 )

SELECT SUM(factura.mimporteconiva) - SUM(ISNULL( retencion.mImporteRetencion, 0) ) AS mTotalFacturaV FROM tPagoFactura factura WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tPagoFacturaRetencion retencion WITH(NOLOCK) ON ( factura.cTipoPago = retencion.cTipoPago AND factura.nFolioPago = retencion.nFolioPago AND retencion.cNombreRetencion LIKE '%CEDULAR%' ) WHERE factura.nFolioPago = ? AND factura.cTipoPago = ? GROUP BY factura.cTipoPago, factura.nFolioPago
SELECT COUNT(*) tieneCedular FROM tPagoFacturaRetencion WHERE nFolioPago= ? AND ( cNombreRetencion like '%5%' or cNombreRetencion like '%cedular%')

SELECT SUM(mimporteRetencion) mImporteRetencion5, UUID FROM tPagoFacturaRetencion WHERE (cNombreRetencion LIKE '%5%' OR cNombreRetencion LIKE '%CEDULAR%') AND nFolioPago = ? AND cTipoPago = 'PAGODIRECTO' GROUP BY UUID

SELECT pagoDirectoEncabezado.caNoContrarrecibo AS caNoContrarrecibo, pagoDirectoEncabezado.cIdTipoDocumento AS idTipoDocumento, pagoDirectoEncabezado.cIdTipoDocumento AS catIdTipoOperacion, CONVERT( VARCHAR(16), pagoDirectoEncabezado.fAplicacion, 103) AS fAplicacion, pagoDirectoEncabezado.ID_DESTINO_GASTO AS DESTINO_GASTO, pagoDirectoEncabezado.ID_DESTINO_GASTO AS ID_DESTINO_GASTO, pagoDirectoEncabezado.ID_DESTINO_GASTO AS idDestinoGasto, pagoDirectoEncabezado.ID_TIPO_CONCEPTO AS tConcepto, pagoDirectoEncabezado.ID_TIPO_CONCEPTO AS TIPO_CONCEPTO, pagoDirectoEncabezado.ID_TIPO_CONCEPTO AS ID_TIPO_CONCEPTO, pagoDirectoEncabezado.ID_TIPO_MOVIMIENTO AS tmovimiento, pagoDirectoEncabezado.ID_TIPO_MOVIMIENTO AS ID_TIPO_MOVIMIENTO, pagoDirectoEncabezado.cIdRFC AS cIDRFC, pagoDirectoEncabezado.CTAB, beneficiario.dNombre + ISNULL( ' ' + dApellidoPaterno , '' ) + ISNULL( ' ' + dApellidoMaterno, '') AS cnombre, beneficiario.cExtranjero AS esExtranjero, pagoDirectoEncabezado.CTAB, pagoDirectoEncabezado.cConcepto AS DCD_CONCEPTO, nFolioAutSICOP, nFolioSuficiencia, cIDContrato FROM tPagoDirectoEncabezado pagoDirectoEncabezado WITH(NOLOCK) left outer join tBeneficiario beneficiario WITH(NOLOCK) ON pagoDirectoEncabezado.cIdRFC = beneficiario.dRFC WHERE nFolioPagoDirecto = ?

SELECT pago.caNoContrarrecibo AS caNoContrarrecibo, pago.cIdTipoDocumento AS idTipoDocumento, pago.cIdTipoDocumento AS catIdTipoOperacion, CONVERT( VARCHAR(16), pago.fAplicacion, 103) AS fAplicacion, pago.ID_DESTINO_GASTO AS DESTINO_GASTO, pago.ID_DESTINO_GASTO AS ID_DESTINO_GASTO, pago.ID_DESTINO_GASTO AS idDestinoGasto, pago.ID_TIPO_MOVIMIENTO AS tmovimiento, pago.ID_TIPO_MOVIMIENTO AS ID_TIPO_MOVIMIENTO, pago.RFC AS cIDRFC, pago.CTAB, beneficiario.dNombre + ISNULL( ' ' + dApellidoPaterno , '' ) + ISNULL( ' ' + dApellidoMaterno, '') AS cnombre, beneficiario.cExtranjero AS esExtranjero, pago.CTAB, pago.cConcepto AS DCD_CONCEPTO FROM tPAGOFEDERALIZADOEncabezado pago WITH(NOLOCK) inner join tBeneficiario beneficiario WITH(NOLOCK) ON pago.RFC = beneficiario.dRFC WHERE nFolioPAGOFEDERALIZADO = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) AS existeCajaChica FROM tcajadetalle JOIN tEmpleadosCajaChica ON RFC = cRFC WHERE nFoliocaja = ?
SELECT mMontoRemanente FROM tEstadoDeCuentaViaticosEncabezado WHERE nFolioCaja = ?
select 'Seleccione una Opcion' AS descOpcion , '' AS urlOpcion union select nombreReporte, urlReporte from tReportesRelacionesLaborales with(nolock) order by urlOpcion
SELECT CASE WHEN mMontoRemanente = mMontoViaticos THEN 'N' ELSE 'S' END AS tieneComprobaciones FROM tEstadoDeCuentaViaticosEncabezado WHERE nFolioCaja = ?
SELECT ISNULL( SUM(lImpuestoForzoso ), 0 )AS esImpuestoForzoso FROM tRFCPagoSinFacturaPermitido WHERE cRFC = ? AND cTipoPago = ?

SELECT COUNT(*) AS esRGNomina FROM trelaciongastosencabezado enc with(nolock) INNER JOIN trelaciongastosdetalle detalle with(nolock) ON enc.nFolioRELACIONGASTOS = detalle.nFolioRELACIONGASTOS WHERE enc.canocontrarrecibo = ? AND detalle.ep like '%39801%' AND detalle.ID_TIPO_CONCEPTO = 'PI' AND enc.ID_DESTINO_GASTO = '2NRP';

SELECT Sum(totalanticipo) AS restoAmortizar FROM ( SELECT Isnull(Sum(mmontoestimacion), 0) AS totalAnticipo FROM tobrapublicaavancefisico WITH(nolock) WHERE ccvecontrato = ? AND noestimacion = '0' UNION ALL SELECT -Isnull(Sum(mmontoestimacionamortizado), 0) AS totalAnticipo FROM tobrapublicaavancefisico WITH(nolock) WHERE ccvecontrato = ? AND noestimacion <> '0' UNION ALL SELECT +Isnull(Sum(mAnticipoMasIVA), 0) AS totalAnticipo FROM tContratoObraPlurianual WITH(nolock) WHERE ccvecontrato = ? UNION ALL SELECT -Isnull(Sum(mEstimacionAmortizado), 0) AS totalAnticipo FROM tContratoObraPlurianual WITH(nolock) WHERE ccvecontrato = ? UNION ALL SELECT +Isnull(Sum(mTotalAnticipado)-Sum(mTotalAmortizado), 0) AS totalAnticipo FROM pContratoObraAnticipoEFAnterior WITH(nolock) WHERE cIdContrato = ? ) AS pagos
SELECT Count(*) AS existeCaptura FROM tsolicitudviaticosencabezado WITH(nolock) WHERE nFolioSolicitudViaticos = ?

sql.read: SELECT ( SELECT ISNULL(SUM(agenda.DIAS), 0) FROM vSolicitudViaticosAgenda agenda WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE agenda.nNumEmpleadoBeneficiario = ? AND agenda.lEsNacional = 'S' AND 0 = (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM tSolicitudViaticosFirmantes WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioSolicitudViaticos = agenda.Folio AND noEmpleado = agenda.nNumEmpleadoBeneficiario AND nDocRenglon = 2 AND nAutorizado = 1) ) AS nDNacional, ( SELECT ISNULL(SUM(DIAS), 0) FROM vSolicitudViaticosAgenda agenda WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nNumEmpleadoBeneficiario = ? AND lEsNacional = 'N' AND 0 = (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM tSolicitudViaticosFirmantes WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioSolicitudViaticos = agenda.Folio AND noEmpleado = agenda.nNumEmpleadoBeneficiario AND nDocRenglon = 2 AND nAutorizado = 1) ) AS nDInternacional, (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(DIAS), 0) FROM vSolicitudViaticosAgenda WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE Folio = ? ) AS nDEsteFormato, ( SELECT ISNULL(SUM(DIAS), 0) FROM vSolicitudViaticosAgenda agenda WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nNumEmpleadoBeneficiario = ? AND 0 = (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM tSolicitudViaticosFirmantes WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioSolicitudViaticos = agenda.Folio AND noEmpleado = agenda.nNumEmpleadoBeneficiario AND nDocRenglon = 1 AND nAutorizado = 0) ) AS nDPendientes, (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(TotalImporte), 0) FROM vSolicitudViaticosAgenda WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE Folio = ? ) AS mImporteAgenda, (SELECT CONVERT(DECIMAL(13,2),ISNULL(SUM(mMonto), 0)) FROM tSolicitudViaticosTransporte WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE nFolioSolicitudViaticos = ? ) AS mTransporte

DECLARE @FechaInicial DATETIME, @FechaFinal DATETIME, @FechaCont DATETIME, @iExisteFinSemana INT
SET @FechaInicial = ? SET @FechaFinal = ? SET @FechaCont = @FechaInicial SET @iExisteFinSemana = 0
WHILE @FechaCont <= @FechaFinal BEGIN IF ((SELECT DATEPART(dw, @FechaCont)) = 6 OR (SELECT DATEPART(dw, @FechaCont)) = 7 ) BEGIN SET @FechaCont = @FechaFinal SET @iExisteFinSemana = 1 END ELSE BEGIN SET @FechaCont = @FechaCont + 1 END END
IF @iExisteFinSemana = 0 BEGIN IF EXISTS( SELECT * FROM tDiasInhabiles WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE fecha BETWEEN @FechaInicial AND @FechaFinal ) BEGIN SET @iExisteFinSemana = 1 END END
SELECT @iExisteFinSemana AS existeFinSemana

SELECT csubcuenta, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 1 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ), 103) AS eneroDisp, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 2 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS febreroDisp, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 3 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS marzoDisp, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 4 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS abrilDisp, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 5 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS mayoDisp, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 6 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS junioDisp, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 7 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS julioDisp, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 8 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS agostoDisp, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 9 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS septiembreDisp, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 10 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS octubreDisp, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 11 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS noviembreDisp, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 12 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS diciembreDisp FROM ( SELECT csubcuenta, CAST(Substring(ncuenta, 7, 5) AS INT) AS nMes, msaldoarrastre FROM tsaldos WHERE ncuenta IN( '82106-00001-00000-00000', '82106-00002-00000-00000', '82106-00003-00000-00000', '82106-00004-00000-00000', '82106-00005-00000-00000', '82106-00006-00000-00000', '82106-00007-00000-00000', '82106-00008-00000-00000', '82106-00009-00000-00000', '82106-00010-00000-00000', '82106-00011-00000-00000', '82106-00012-00000-00000' ) AND csubcuenta = ? ) AS saldos GROUP BY csubcuenta

SELECT ep, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 1 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ), 103) AS eneroCompr, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 2 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS febreroCompr, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 3 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS marzoCompr, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 4 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS abrilCompr, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 5 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS mayoCompr, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 6 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS junioCompr, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 7 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS julioCompr, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 8 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS agostoCompr, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 9 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS septiembreCompr, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 10 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS octubreCompr, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 11 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS noviembreCompr, CONVERT( VARCHAR(32), SUM( CASE WHEN nMes = 12 THEN msaldoarrastre ELSE 0 END ) , 103)AS diciembreCompr, SUM( msaldoarrastre ) AS totalCalendarizado
FROM ( SELECT ep, nMes, mImporte AS msaldoarrastre FROM pContratoFederalizadoDetalle WHERE cEjercicio = ? AND cIdEntidadContable = ? AND cIdContrato = ? ) AS saldos WHERE ep = ? GROUP BY ep

SELECT contrato.mTotal - ISNULL(calendario.totalCalendarizado, 0) AS faltanteCalendario FROM pcontratofederalizado contrato LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT cEjercicio, cIdEntidadContable, cIdContrato, Sum(importeCalendarizado) AS totalCalendarizado FROM vcontratofederalizadoep GROUP BY cEjercicio, cIdEntidadContable, cIdContrato ) AS calendario ON contrato.cEjercicio = calendario.cEjercicio AND contrato.cIdEntidadContable = calendario.cIdEntidadContable and contrato.cIdContrato = calendario.cIdContrato WHERE contrato.cEjercicio = ? SELECT SUM(retencionesFactura - ISNULL( retencionesCalculadas, 0 )) AS diferencia FROM ( SELECT nFolioPagoDirecto, SUM(mImporteRetencion) AS retencionesFactura,0 retencionesCalculadas FROM tPagoDirectoRetencion pagoRetencion WHERE nFolioPagoDirecto = ? GROUP BY nFolioPagoDirecto UNION SELECT nFolioPago AS nFolioPagoDirecto, 0 retencionesCalculadas ,SUM(mImporteRetencion) AS retencionesCalculadas FROM tPagoFacturaRetencion facturas WHERE cTipoPago = 'PAGODIRECTO' AND nFolioPago = ? GROUP BY nFoliopago ) AS pagoFederalizado LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT nFolioPago AS nFolioPago, SUM(mImporteRetencion) AS retencionesCalculadas FROM tPagoFacturaRetencion facturas WHERE cTipoPago = ? AND nFolioPago = ? GROUP BY cTipoPago, nFolioPago ) AS facturas ON pagoFederalizado.nFoliopago = facturas.nFoliopago

GROUP BY pagoDirecto.nFolioPagoDirecto ) AS retencionesPago LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT pagoRetencion.nFolioPagoDirecto, SUM(mimporteRetencion) AS retencionCapturada FROM tPagoDirectoRetencion pagoRetencion WHERE pagoRetencion.nFolioPagoDirecto = ? SELECT c.cidcontrato AS claveContrato, CASE vc.ctcont WHEN 'OB' THEN 'OBRA' WHEN 'DI' THEN 'DIVERSO' WHEN 'CN' THEN 'DIVERSO' WHEN 'PD' THEN 'DIRECTO' ELSE 'FEDERALIZADO' END AS tipoContrato, vc. ctipocontratodiverso AS tipoDocumento, vc.cunidadresponsable + ' ' + vc.d_descripcion AS unidadAdministrativa, Isnull(vc.ctipoadjudicacion, '') AS tipoAdjudicacion, vc.cidrfc AS ruc, vc.cnombre AS nombre, c.cdescripcionpoliza AS conceptoContrato, vc.mimportetotal AS montoContrato, Sum(cd.mimporte) AS compromisoActual FROM tcompromisoencabezado c INNER JOIN tcompromisodetalle cd ON c.nfoliocompromiso = cd.nfoliocompromiso INNER JOIN vContratoCompromisoConsulta vc ON c.cidcontrato = vc.cidcontrato WHERE c.nfoliocompromiso = ?
